content: Upstream requirements: SRS_Os_80020 The IocSend / IocWrite function shall support mechanism to guarantee data- Integrity during transmission. The IocSend / IocWrite function shall solve the crossing of the protection boundaries of OS-Applications. It has to be generated in case of intra-core and inter-core commu- nication.
